message: No detected input validation: The code uses argparse defaults and dictionary lookups for MODEL/DATASET keys but performs no explicit validation of data structure, dtype, shape, or value ranges on the ingested data.

No detected untrusted source handling: There is no evidence of remote data fetching (URLs, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) or any integrity verification such as checksums or authentication in the visible code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, checks label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads datasets and passes them directly to models without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds and trains models from scratch in memory using Keras; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, so there is no integrity verification mechanism present.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: Models are trained with standard Keras Adam optimizer and no DP-SGD, Opacus, or TensorFlow Privacy mechanisms are used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress testing in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (F1, precision, recall, PR-AUC, ROC-AUC) are computed, there is no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and no explicit isolation enforcement of the test set from training beyond the data loader split; thresholds are set on the test data itself (set_thresholds uses x_test),

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on data before passing it to the model; the code directly uses loaded arrays from data loaders without any sanitization checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model predictions (rec_x) are used directly for scoring and evaluation without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or output bounds validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses time-series autoencoder models (CNN-AE, GRU-AE, LSTM-AE, etc.), not LLMs, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
